item.title: Google: AI Mode Checkout Can’t Raise Prices
item.description: Google responds to “personalized upselling” criticism tied to its AI Mode checkout, saying upselling means premium options, not higher prices. The post Google: AI Mode Checkout Can’t Raise Prices appeared first on Search Engine Journal.

item.title: Social Media Trust Is Breaking Down (And How You Can Rebuild It)
item.description: Bots, fake reviews, and undisclosed AI are eroding trust on social media, creating a competitive advantage for brands that prioritize authenticity and real human experience. item.title: YouTube Expands Monetization For Some Controversial Issues
